description: This file provides mock classes, data structures, and utility functions for testing HTTP transactions within the Chromium project. It includes mock transaction data, transaction handling, network layer simulation, and callback mechanisms for testing HTTP request/response workflows.

classes.name: MockTransaction
classes.description: Represents a mock HTTP transaction with configurable parameters for testing.

classes.name: MockHttpRequest
classes.description: Represents a mock HTTP request based on a MockTransaction.

classes.name: TestTransactionConsumer
classes.description: Utility class to test complete consumption of an HTTP transaction.

classes.name: MockNetworkTransaction
classes.description: Simulates an HTTP network transaction, supporting synchronous and asynchronous operations for testing.

classes.name: MockNetworkLayer
classes.description: Simulates a network layer managing mock transactions and their lifecycle.

classes.name: ConnectedHandler
classes.description: Handles injection of connected callbacks for testing connection behaviors.

methods.name: DefaultTransportInfo
methods.description: Provides default transport info for mock transactions.

methods.name: FindMockTransaction
methods.description: Retrieves a mock transaction for a given URL.

methods.name: AddMockTransaction
methods.description: Adds a mock transaction to the internal registry.

methods.name: RemoveMockTransaction
methods.description: Removes a mock transaction from the internal registry.

methods.name: ReadTransaction
methods.description: Reads the entire transaction data into a string.
